vo.text: In 1990, Voyager 1 was six billion kilometers from home.
Carl Sagan pushed NASA to turn its camera back toward Earth, one last time.
vo.cap: Carl Sagan: turn the camera *back toward Earth.*

vo.text: In the photo, Earth is less than one pixel. Zero point one two of a pixel.
Soon after, Voyager's cameras were switched off. For good.
vo.cap: Then its cameras were *switched off.* For good.

cta.q: Did you spot the dot first?
